text: アキホさまの　ほほえみは　たいようの　かがやきにも　おとりません　どうぞ　アキホさまを　よろこばせて　あげて　ください

structure.jp: アキホさまの　ほほえみは
たいようの　かがやきにも　おとりません
structure.en: is not inferior even to the sun's brilliance

structure.jp: どうぞ　アキホさまを
よろこばせて　あげて　ください

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: The せる ending on a verb means making someone do or feel it. よろこぶ 'be glad' becomes よろこばせて = 'make (her) glad'.

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.span: よろこばせて　あげて
patterns.explanation: てあげる after a verb says the action is done as a kindness for someone. よろこばせて　あげて = 'make her happy, for her'.

patterns.name: 〜にもおとらない
patterns.span: かがやきにも　おとりません
patterns.explanation: にもおとらない says something is every bit as good as the thing named, however great that is. かがやきにも　おとりません = 'is no less than even (the sun's) brilliance'.
